title: Sync to live's preview on a WordPress site whose wp-config.php differs between the last sync and the copy names the changed settings instead of stopping with CHANGESET_FAILED (AttributeError in config_changes)
expect: S1: the wp-config.php case names DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT and WP_DEBUG as no-safe-action settings, the database host is left out as environment, and every other changeset case still passes
fence: A Sync to live preview never stops on a difference it only has to name
